title: Isospectral majorization and isoperimetric inequalities for coherent states on the Bloch sphere
summary: Let $\mathcal{P}_{N}$ be the $(N+1)$-dimensional Hilbert space of analytic polynomials of degree at most $N$. This is the natural environment to define $SU(2)$ (Bloch) coherent states. Let $Q_{ρ}$ be the Husimi function of a density operator $ρ$ on $% \mathcal{P}_{N}$. We prove an isospectral version of Lieb-Solovej inequality: if $ρ^{\downarrow }$ is obtained by placing the eigenvalues of $ρ$ in decreasing order along the monomial basis, then \begin{equation*} \int_{\mathbb{C}}Φ(Q_{ρ}(z))\,dm(z)\leq \int_{\mathbb{C}}Φ(Q_{ρ^{\downarrow }}(z))\,dm(z) \end{equation*}% for every convex function…
